subject: Is it possible to change the IDs in the URLs of tabPanels? (app/#tab-2198-1)

messages.author: 48725385c294169f
messages.subject: Is it possible to change the IDs in the URLs of tabPanels? (app/#tab-2198-1)
parts:
Just a minor peeve, but when you hover over tabset links, you see #tab-2198-1, #tab-2198-2, #tab-2198-3, and so on.

It would be great if we could give these more descriptive names like #server_R_code, #ui_R_code.
